origine_fr: Le bois 木 et 奇, qui donnait le son mais se lit qí. Au départ, 椅 est le nom d'un arbre. Le sens « chaise », meuble de bois, est venu plus tard.
origine_en: Wood 木 with 奇, which gave the sound but is read qí. At first, 椅 was the name of a tree. The meaning “chair”, a wooden piece of furniture, came later.
